niki: Quick rollup from the DR postmortem  I distilled 6 follow-ups. Need owners, minimal test scope, and a clear abort condition. Posting the list now.
omar: I'll take routing validation + safe flip script. Deliverable: audited route table + `flip.sh` with `--dry-run/--run` modes. Will run sandbox sim Wed.
frank: I'll own backups & restore docs. Plan: one full restore in staging and a short checklist for volunteers.
tara: I'll run the game-day dry run coordination and invite EU SREs. Propose Thu 11:00 PT.
omar: Routing test modes: region outage (simulate), AZ-level isolate, and peering throttling. I'll capture RTO, 95th latency, and error rate. Expect CSV + short graph.
frank: Minimal restore steps (short):
```
- verify snapshot: `gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="redwood-prod-db" --limit=1`
- restore to dr-test: `terraform apply -var=dr_test=true`
- run smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh --target dr-test`
- data spot-check: `python tools/sample_check.py --count 5`
```
tara: Game-day checklist draft: announce 24h prior, IAM precheck, snapshot verify, routing sim (omar), cache warmup check (post-flip), smoke tests (frank), retro + artifacts.
omar: Add cache validation: sample 10 keys 5m post-flip, run 10m, fail if miss rate >8%. Will post results to the incident board.
frank: Found one bucket with 14d retention; opening infra ticket to extend to 90d and to add daily incrementals.
niki: Owners & due dates (short): routing -> omar -> due 2180600000; backups+runbook -> frank -> due 2180450000; dry-run invites -> tara -> due 2180380000; IAM checklist -> frank -> due 2180365000; retro doc -> all -> due 2180800000.
ops-bot: reminder: when tests run, tag artifacts with `incident:DR-2026` and post summary to the tracker.
frank: Acceptance criteria (minimal): restore health endpoint within 30m, sample check = 0 mismatches; routing RTO < 5m in sandbox; cache miss rate <=8% within 10m.
tara: I'll lock the slot after EU on-call confirms and publish run-of-show.
omar: I'll push the flip script with safe defaults and attach first sandbox CSV after tomorrow's sim.
niki: Goal: compact repeatable playbook, owners, measurable pass/fail, and clear abort thresholds. I'll create the action-tracker card and assign P0 to routing and restore. Ping here if you need perms or quota. :thumbsup:
